_meta.status: UNSIGNED — NOT FOR PROSPECT USE. There is no committed source of truth for XBorderCo's enabled countries: the live list is runtime database state (supported_countries), and neither xbc-docs nor the MVP repo carries a checked-in copy. Until an owner fills the lists below and sets status to 'signed', compute/market-coverage.ts refuses to produce a coverage section and the report omits it. Do NOT populate this from memory — a wrong 'covered today' is the one claim in the report a prospect can disprove in month one.
_meta.note: Same discipline as thresholds.json and supported-providers.json: XBC facts live in data files so they are auditable and updatable without touching any instruction text.

statuses.covered_today: XBorderCo is registered and filing in this jurisdiction now, and can be activated for a merchant on onboarding.
statuses.roadmap: Not available yet. 'expected' states when, and is a plan rather than a commitment.
statuses.not_planned: No current plan to support this jurisdiction.
statuses.out_of_scope: Outside what XBorderCo does at all — most commonly the merchant's own domestic obligations in their country of establishment.

roadmap.name: United States
roadmap.note: Confirmed unavailable through 2026 (John, 26 Aug 2026). Sub-jurisdiction scope (which states, at what point) not yet defined — fill before this row is quoted.

out_of_scope_rule: The merchant's head-office country, taken from their Stripe tax settings, is always reported as out of scope: domestic VAT/GST in the country you are established in is your own obligation and is never assessed by this analysis.
